mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO partner for my remodeling company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right AEO partner for your remodeling company requires careful consideration. Look for an agency with proven experience specifically in the remodeling or home services industry, as they will understand your unique customer journey and terminology. Evaluate their track record of generating tangible results, such as increased featured snippets, direct answers, and lead generation. Request case studies or client testimonials. Ensure they offer transparent reporting, clear communication, and a customized strategy tailored to your business goals and service areas. A strong partner will prioritize understanding your specific needs and delivering measurable value.
